$comment: Story Planner templates. Placeholders: {feedName} {fileCount} {tables} {columnCount} {rowCount} {piiCount} {pciCount} {tbdCount}. 'blockedBy' lists template keys that must finish first (creates Jira 'Blocks' links).

epic.context: Onboard the {feedName} feed: {fileCount} file(s) ({tables}), {columnCount} columns, {rowCount} rows profiled. {piiCount} PII and {pciCount} PCI columns identified; {tbdCount} spec fields still need a decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the feed spec, when every child story is done, then the feed is live in the analytics zone
Given the spec pages, when a reviewer opens them, then no field is left TBD

stories.context: Data owners review the column spec for {tables} and resolve the {tbdCount} open fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the published spec, when the data owner reviews each file, then every file is marked approved
Given a PII or PCI column, when it is reviewed, then its classification and masking are confirmed

stories.context: Load {fileCount} file(s) into the raw zone and transform them into curated tables using the target names and types from the spec.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a feed delivery, when the load runs, then every source column lands in its target column with the specified type
Given a row that breaks a type or nullability rule, when the load runs, then it is rejected and logged, not silently changed

stories.context: Publish analytics-ready tables for {tables} with masking applied to the {piiCount} PII and {pciCount} PCI columns.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an analytics user, when they query the tables, then sensitive columns are masked as specified
Given the curated tables, when the model refreshes, then row counts reconcile with the curated zone

stories.context: Design data checks for {columnCount} columns: existence, type, length, nullability, keys, relationships and masking.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the approved spec, when test design is done, then every column has at least one check
Given each check, when it is reviewed, then its expected result quotes the spec exactly

stories.context: Run the designed checks against the curated and analytics tables and record results.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the test plan, when it is executed, then every check has a pass or fail result
Given a failed check, when it is triaged, then a defect is linked to this story

stories.context: Business users confirm the {feedName} data meets their needs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the analytics tables, when business users validate sample reports, then they sign off in this story

stories.context: Promote the {feedName} pipelines and tables to production and hand over to operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Given business sign-off, when the release runs, then the first production load completes and reconciles
Given operations, when they receive the hand-over, then the run book links to the spec pages
